template_data.headline_html: Five SAM.gov mistakes that freeze your contracts.

items.title: Expired registration
items.sub: No reminder comes — agencies can't pay you when you're lapsed

items.title: Too few NAICS codes
items.sub: COs search by code — invisible if your service isn't listed

items.title: Stale points of contact
items.sub: Old emails kill bid invitations before they land

items.title: Unchecked reps & certs
items.sub: Regs update; auto-rolled answers can flag compliance issues

items.title: Wrong banking info
items.sub: Awards delay when payment details point to a closed account
